verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gitea can migrate repositories from another source: docs mention migrating repositories from Gogs, and a user migrated the TiDB repo onto a Gitea instance. Nothing shows that issues, pull requests, reviews, or comments come along, and one user found migrating existing repos surprisingly difficult. Missing for 10: documented import of issues, pull requests, reviews and comments, a list of supported source platforms (e.g. GitHub/GitLab), and first-party migration docs with hands-on corroboration of a full-fidelity import.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can import repositories from another hosting platform along with their issues, pull requests, reviews, and comments

citations.quote: The recommended method is to migrate repositories from Gogs to Gitea.
Migrated the TiDB repo to the 'Try Gitea' service
